# L4 metadata version 1 golden vectors (M4 design A3.5). Hand-written,
# independent of the encoder. Before v2.0.0 a change is deliberate and
# recorded in the milestone report. After v2.0.0 a frozen vector changes
# only with a new wire minor version, an optional PREFACE feature bit, or a
# new version of a versioned payload format such as L4 metadata.
#
#   ok  <name> <hex> <Request.Addr> <Request.App as hex, or ->
#   bad <name> <hex or -> <code: BadRequest BadVersion BadCommand BadAddress>
#
# TestL4MetadataGolden_L44 also rejects every ok vector's header truncated
# by one byte (BadAddress).
